checks.name: Sommelier find page copy
checks.details: Page loaded; describes matching wines listed in this store's catalogue; no longer claims AI is asking the questions.

checks.name: Deterministic recommendation
checks.details: POST /api/ai/sommelier/recommend returned HTTP 200/code 0 with one in-stock DEMO Shiraz recommendation at AUD 34.90 and stock quantity 12.

checks.name: Catalogue identify
checks.details: GET /api/ai/sommelier/identify?q=DEMO returned HTTP 200/code 0 with two current DEMO catalogue items.

checks.name: Wine details and deterministic assistance
checks.details: Wine detail, pitch and ask endpoints for Odoo product 62 returned HTTP 200/code 0; text responses were populated.

checks.name: Similar cheaper alternatives
checks.details: Endpoint returned HTTP 200/code 0 and no alternatives for the DEMO Shiraz, consistent with the current catalogue having no cheaper same-style in-stock wine.

checks.name: No production writes or model calls
checks.details: Only GET and deterministic read-only recommendation/pitch/ask requests were sent; feedback endpoint, image recognition, model services, sales, stock, and Odoo write operations were not called.

limitations: The production test used the live two-item DEMO catalogue. It does not simulate Odoo returning an empty response; the new unit test covers prevention of Classic MySQL fallback when configured Odoo is empty.
Sommelier still reads Odoo list_price and qty_available; parity with POS effective pricelist and outlet-specific free_qty has not been verified.

GitHub push did not automatically create a Dokploy deployment record in this run. A correctly shaped main-branch push webhook request was needed to trigger deployment; autodeploy delivery remains to be repaired or independently proven.
